major_cooldowns.name: Colossus Smash
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown and pack Bladestorm, Ravager or Demolish into the 10 second debuff, since delaying it desyncs every other cooldown.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 167105 is the cast id; 208086 is the aura id used by the rules.

major_cooldowns.name: Avatar
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it shortly before or together with Colossus Smash and fire on-use stat trinkets in the same window.

major_cooldowns.name: Bladestorm
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it inside Colossus Smash after topping up Imminent Demise with an Execute, and take the next window rather than sitting on it when its own cooldown reduction breaks alignment.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Three ids share this name; 446035 is the one seen in casts and as the self aura, 227847 is the id the guide text links.

major_cooldowns.name: Sweeping Strikes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: On two or more targets press it while Colossus Smash is still on cooldown so it covers the whole burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Ravager
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it just before Colossus Smash so its ticks land inside the debuff.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses, which all ran Slayer; 228920 is the castable id and 156287 is the talent node.

major_cooldowns.name: Demolish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside Colossus Smash once Colossal Might hits 10 stacks, or delay it to the last seconds of the debuff to bank extra stacks.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses, which all ran Slayer; 436358 carries the 30s cooldown, 440884 has no cooldown.

rule.description: Open with Charge into Avatar and Colossus Smash
rule.action: Charge in at the pull, then press Avatar just before Colossus Smash and dump the rest inside that window.
Press Avatar shortly before Colossus Smash so the two windows overlap.
Wait for the Colossus Smash debuff to land before you start Bladestorm.
Channel Demolish inside Colossus Smash at 10 stacks of Colossal Might, or in the debuff's last seconds to bank more.

rule.description: Keep Rend bleeding on the target
rule.action: Refresh Rend with Cleave before it falls off, and top it up as Colossus Smash comes back.

rule.description: Spend Sudden Death procs with Execute
rule.action: Fire Execute while the proc is up, and press it straight away once it reaches two stacks.

rule.description: Execute takes over from Slam in execute range
rule.action: Drop Slam and pour your rage into Execute once the target is in execute range.

rule.description: Bladestorm at full Imminent Demise stacks
rule.action: Squeeze an Execute in immediately before Bladestorm to reach 3 stacks of Imminent Demise.
